    first_name = serializers.CharField(allow_blank=True)
    last_name = serializers.CharField(allow_blank=True)
    username = serializers.CharField(allow_blank=True)


class PetSummarySerializer(serializers.Serializer[Any]):
    id = serializers.CharField()
    name = serializers.CharField()

    def _resolve_care_subject(
        self,
        *,
        family: FamilyGroup,
        care_subject_type: Any = None,
        care_subject_id: Any = None,
    ) -> Any | None:
        normalized_type = str(care_subject_type or "").strip().lower()
        normalized_id = str(care_subject_id or "").strip()
        if not normalized_id:
            return None
        if normalized_type in {"person", "user", "family_member", "adult", "elder"}:
            user = User.objects.filter(id=normalized_id).first()
            if (
                user is None
                or not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                    family=family, user=user, is_active=True
                ).exists()
            ):
                raise serializers.ValidationError(
                    {"care_subject_id": "Selected care subject is not in your family."}
                )
            return user
        if normalized_type in {"", "pet", "animal"}:
            pet = Pet.objects.filter(id=normalized_id, family=family).first()
            if pet is None:
                raise serializers.ValidationError(
                    {"care_subject_id": "Selected care subject is not in your family."}
                )
            return pet
        raise serializers.ValidationError(
            {"care_subject_type": "Use pet or person for the care subject type."}
        )

        if care_subject is None:
            task.care_subject_content_type = None
            task.care_subject_object_id = ""
            return
        task.care_subject_content_type = ContentType.objects.get_for_model(
            care_subject, for_concrete_model=False
        )
        task.care_subject_object_id = str(care_subject.pk)

    def get_medication_state(self, obj: Any) -> Any:
        if obj.task_kind != FamilyTask.TaskKind.MEDICATION:
            return None
        if obj.status != FamilyTask.Status.PENDING:
            return None
        from django.utils import timezone

        now = timezone.now()
        due_window_end_at = obj.due_window_end_at
        due_window_start_at = obj.due_window_start_at
        is_as_needed = bool(obj.task_series and obj.task_series.is_as_needed)
        if is_as_needed:
            if due_window_start_at is None or now >= due_window_start_at:
                return "available"
            return "due_around"
        if due_window_end_at is not None and now > due_window_end_at:
            return "overdue"
        if due_window_start_at is not None and now >= due_window_start_at:
            if due_window_end_at is not None and timedelta(
                0
            ) <= due_window_end_at - now <= timedelta(hours=1):
                return "window_closing"
            return "due_around"
        return "due_around"
